metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a standing sciatic nerve release that may provide relief from sciatic pain in as little as 30 seconds.

This technique works by alleviating tension and pressure along the sciatic nerve pathway, from the lower back down to the leg and foot.

Give it a try and let us know your results!
